concept: heat-warped underground film-computation vault climate-model tape salvage
negative_en: distorted fingers, excessive HDR, illustration look, unrealistic hands, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, 3D render look, broken window geometry, warped walls, over-processed retouching
prompt_en:
Create a single photorealistic vertical social editorial photograph inside a heat-warped underground film-computation vault during an emergency archive salvage. Use the supplied portrait solely as a visible adult appearance reference: one visibly adult woman with long dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a neutral expression, a black blouse, and a small gold necklace. She salvages the final climate-model tape by bracing at a central recovery console while pulling a continuous translucent punched-film strip out of an oxidized brass logic wheel inches from the camera; the strip crosses her hands, threads through flooded calculation machinery, and reaches a blinking cold-storage tower deep in the vault. The vertical social frame places the wheel in the lower corner, the adult at center, and the distant tower high in the same uninterrupted image. A visibly extreme foreground-to-distance scale relationship that remains legible in a vertical social photograph. Rectilinear phone-camera breadth with a stable centered human anchor and progressively stronger edge stretch. Compose so that a very broad field of view spans the wheel, both side aisles, the centered console, and the remote tower in one rectilinear exposure. Scale the scene so the near foreground is relatively enlarged, with the brass wheel dominating the lower corner while the woman remains fully readable at mid-distance and the tower is tiny but distinct. Across the frame, edge-directed stretching increases toward the outer edges across the wheel rim, acetate strips, and side machinery, while her upright figure forms a stable central perspective anchor with straight central verticals. Ensure that the phone-close camera position or a foreground-to-distance action path is realized by the camera beside the wheel and the continuous unspooling tape leading to the remote tower. Green emergency strips cut through low sea mist, glinting on buckled acetate, oxidized brass, shallow water, and heat-stressed machinery. Render realistic smartphone optics, documentary skin and fabric texture, tactile physical deterioration, coherent hands gripping the tape, and one continuous physical event.

Avoid: distorted fingers, excessive HDR, illustration look, unrealistic hands, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, 3D render look, broken window geometry, warped walls, over-processed retouching
